name: tab-triage
description: Prioritize the tabs eating your RAM, then stash them without losing them.
author: Martin Anderson-Clutz

scripts.zip: cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; rm -f tab-triage.zip && zip -rq tab-triage.zip manifest.json README.md LICENSE src icons -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'wrote tab-triage.zip'
